entries.operation_fingerprint: Use original SideStore Team.account.appleID and Account.isActiveAccount relationship plus native AuthManager currentAppleID to determine selected account and team. Pin both immutable strings across device install, managed slot listing/update, refresh query and host bootstrap; fail closed on owner mismatch even where Team identifier alone matches.
entries.source_behavior_contract: Each Apple ID owns its own Team and managed app records; installation and refresh can touch only exact Account+Team owned rows. Switching B never transfers or mutates A apps or Scarlet host signed Team; no Apple entitlement spoof, global certificate overwrite, app deletions, or shared slot ownership inferred from Team alone.

novelty.causal_difference: P68 and P75 gate active Team ID but never compare SideStore CoreData Team.account appleID; this allows same-Team distinct Apple IDs to see or change each others records and makes install callback ownership ambiguous. The original persisted Team.account relationship is now used in every operation.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: A and B each see only their own managed app rows and install/readback validates both account and Team. A same-Team different-AppleID app is blocked from B refresh and slot actions, without re-signing host or revoking certificates.

new_device_evidence.observed_value: Selected Team 0 targets then manually selected 1 target; P89 uses only team relationship in native worker

novelty.why_prior_fix_failed: Earlier source changes applied only Team ID filtering or host origin; neither enforced installed-app CoreData Team.account.appleID equality or post-install callback ownership confirmation.

after: - User requirement: Apple ID A and Apple ID B MUST be independently owned identities, not a shared permission switch. Device P89 current launch `022f7fbc` (source `c667fa3cd4b1`) shows account switching verified and one selected-Team P12 import, but guest `certificate_invalid`/`signature_postcheck_invalid`, auto refresh selectedTeam no-app and manual refresh install-unverified. These remain unresolved, not CI successes.

- Original SideStore CoreData has `InstalledApp.team -> Team.account -> Account.appleID`, plus `Team.isActiveTeam` and `Account.isActiveAccount`; P68/P75/P89 only filtered by Team ID, which cannot distinguish two Apple IDs sharing a Developer Team. P90 instead pins both authenticated `AuthManager.currentAppleID` AND native active Team relationship under SideStore gate for IPA install, managed slots, refresh and original signed-host bootstrap.

- Native install callback must read back the same `InstalledApp.team.account.appleID` plus `Team.identifier` before claiming pipeline success. No cross-account activate/deactivate, auto-switch, app deletion, revocation, transfer, or rewriting signed host authority. Identity unavailable => fail closed. Existing signed Scarlet host stays with its original Team, even if B is selected.

- P90 code changes scoped to `ScarletGuestSavedAccounts.swift.txt`, `ScarletDeviceInstallAgent.swift.txt`, `ScarletGuestRefreshAgent.swift.txt`, tests and workflow only. P89 native account UI untouched; P89 SideStore per-Team P12 import untouched.

- P90 static acceptance uses two Apple IDs even when Developer Team is the same; static tests cannot substitute for iOS27.2 device signing, installed-app per-owner lists or user screenshot. Check A->B->A and app-slot, native install, per-owner refresh.

entries.action: P90 binds AppManager installed app ownership to native SideStore Team.account relation and supports append-only full-history merging for audit and iPhone log.
entries.observation: Local Linux source tests: 861 run, 3 infra skips. Prior to append test one coverage test blocked missing L149; with append should pass. Xcode CI and user iPhone A/B isolation not verified.
entries.evidence: P89 session 022f7fbc and exact original SideStore Account->Team->InstalledApp relationships; source commit receipt.
entries.next_executable_action: Xcode27.2 native compile and IPA publish, then signed iPhone A-B-A verification of per-account app ownership and manual/automatic refresh.
entries.repeat_policy: Never rely only on Developer Team ID or silently transfer signed-host ownership; keep intact P89 signing baseline.

entries.operation_fingerprint: On a kernel signature postcheck failure, obtain the uniquely owned same-host-team active CertificateManager archive via authenticated original SideStore XPC instead of legacy generic Keychain, then pass to existing crash-safe kernel postcheck transaction.
entries.source_behavior_contract: Only when exactly one saved Apple ID is active and uniquely owns the installed signed host Team, retrieve its existing native SideStore P12 over authenticated XPC; recheck owner after XPC, validate PKCS12 Team and distinctness, run original P78 reversible trial, fail closed and roll back if signature is rejected.

novelty.causal_difference: P78 only queried fixed legacy generic Keychain service items and found no alternate certificate for the P90 device. P89 installed per-account certificates into SideStore CertificateManager, which P78 never inspected. P91 adds the authenticated native CertificateManager retrieval route restricted by account+team owner, while preserving P78 reversible kernel verification.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: P91 on-device native fallback only starts if original same-host-team legacy candidate is absent; with unique active host-team owner and distinct native P12 it begins one kernel-verified reversible trial, whereas missing/cross-team/same-Team multi-owner candidates do not modify LC signing state and no invalid signature is accepted.

new_device_evidence.observed_value: P90 session 93bd3576 had 3 guest signing errors, 3 signature postcheck invalid results, per-account P12 import success for B, no P78 signer_recovery_trial_started; P78 legacy candidate unavailable path is not proven as log omitted its completion.

novelty.why_prior_fix_failed: P78 only queried generic Keychain service and could not reach P89 per-account original SideStore CertificateManager. P89 saves certificates but does not automatically hand a verified host-team candidate into LC guest signing transaction. P90 only enforces app ownership without fixing this certificate store gap.

after: // P91: the original SideStore CertificateManager is NOT the legacy
// generic Keychain service that P78 searched. The native archive is
// fetched only for one unambiguous active Apple ID that owns the signed
// host team, never for an arbitrary selected second account.
// A and B remain independent even when Apple assigned the SAME
// Developer Team. Without a unique owner we cannot infer who owns
// this installed host from its Team entitlement alone.
// Read the REAL SideStore active CertificateManager archive via
// existing on-device XPC; do not create/revoke Apple certificates.
// Reuse P78's transaction, kernel readback and exact rollback;
// only the certificate origin is different, not the sign method.

### L150 · P91 원본 SideStore CertificateManager 기반 게스트 서명 복구 (2026-11-17)

- 2026-11-17 08:29 KST P90 실기기 로그(빌드 3.8.90, SourceCommit `9a3ded62e0f1`, session `93bd3576`): `certificate_preflight`의 P12·서명호스트 팀 일치와 AppGroup 통과에도 실제 게스트 3회 `certificate_invalid` / `signature_postcheck_invalid`; A/B 전환 성공, 계정별 P12 가져오기 성공, 자동 갱신 선택 팀의 관리 앱 수는 0. 이는 수동 가져오기와 게스트 JIT-less 커널 서명 성공이 별개의 경로임을 입증한다.

- 원본 LC 소스 `LCUtils.validateJITLessSetup`은 시험용 dylib를 `ZSigner`로 서명한 후 커널 `checkCodeSignature`를 검사한다. 기존 P78 복구는 `com.SideStore.SideStore` 등의 레거시 generic Keychain `signingCertificate`만 조회하므로 P89가 추가한 원본 SideStore `CertificateManager`의 계정별 활성 P12에 도달하지 못한다. 기존 실패를 타이머·여백·재시도로 처리하지 않는다.

- P91은 기존 P78 후보가 없을 때에만 인증된 SideStore LiveProcess XPC `ScarletNativeCertificateTransport.retrieveSideStoreCertificate()`로 원본 CertificateManager의 **기존** 활성 P12를 조회한다. 저장된 Apple ID 목록은 이전과 이후 두 번 조회하며, **활성 계정 한 개** 및 **호스트 서명 Team에 속한 유일한 계정 한 개**일 때에만 진행한다. 두 Apple ID가 같은 Developer Team이면 자동 교체하지 않는다. 후보 P12가 현재 LC 인증서와 다르고 서명된 호스트 Team과 일치할 때에만 P78의 기존 백업/검증/롤백을 재사용한다. Apple 포털 새 발급, 타 계정 전환, App Group 키 임의 덮어쓰기, 기존 인증서 파기 없음.

- 변경 소스 `rebuild/HostApp/ScarletIntegratedHostView.swift`, `rebuild/Tests/test_v48_r6p91_native_owned_guest_signer.py`, `.github/workflows/scarlet-paired-engines-build.yml`. 정확한 파일·코드 전후 차이와 원격 Git commit SHA들은 append-only `scarlet_remediation_history_appendix.json`의 L150에 기록돼 있다. 기존 P90 계정별 설치 소유권과 UI, P89 인증서 가져오기, V48 화면·회전·멤버십 로직은 변경하지 않았다.

- 신규 소스 계약 테스트 4개 통과는 Xcode 컴파일이나 iPhone JIT-less 성공 증거가 아니다. P91은 빌드 3.8.91·독립 미서명 IPA로 CI를 돌려야 하며, 실기기에서 A→B→A 및 관리 앱 계정 격리, `native_owned_host_team_p12` 복구 시그널과 `signer_recovery_verified`, 실제 게스트 화면/커널 서명, 원본 인증서 미변경 또는 실패 시 롤백을 검증해야 한다. P90의 `no_managed_apps_for_selected_team`은 별도로 등록·소유권 경로 확인이 필요하다.

build(P91): native iOS 27.2 build and separate unsigned release
test(P91): assert native guest signer ownership and reversible recovery
docs(P91): preserve on-device failure evidence and independent native signer recovery handoff

entries.action: P91 adds a unique-account-owned native SideStore certificate lookup after old P78 Keychain candidate exhaustion; reuses original P78 rollback and kernel test, preserving separate Apple ID B signing team, V48 guest geometry and UI.
entries.observation: P90 native CI successful but device guest certificate_invalid/signature_postcheck_invalid persisted. P91 local P91 contracts passed 4 tests; native Xcode and real signed-device recoverability not yet verified.
entries.evidence: P90 3.8.90 session 93bd3576 + pinned LiveContainer LCUtils.validateJITLessSetup source + authenticated SideStore CertificateManager XPC code, full before/after diff.
entries.next_executable_action: Run P91 Xcode27.2 native CI, publish distinct unsigned IPA, then on actual signed phone test A->B->A guest JIT-less code signing and account-owned apps; do not declare success without kernel signature readback and actual guest display.
entries.repeat_policy: No blind P12 replacement, no Team-only ownership inference, no auto portal issuance, no duplicate generic Keychain retry, no guest frame/statusbar changes; failure must restore original AppGroup certificate/password/date.

entries.operation_fingerprint: Restore the real LCJITLessDiagnoseView NavigationLink inside the iOS17+ ScarletSigningReadinessPanel and export its manual test result; separate guest-only locally entitled signer trial from full SideStore refresh prerequisite while retaining reversible kernel validation.
entries.source_behavior_contract: The signed host remains immutable and its Apple Developer Team and accessible App Group must match. The JIT-less diagnostic is visible in the existing native Settings form, its original kernel signing test returns sanitised current-launch JSONL, and candidate-only local recovery does not silently require the stronger installed-app identifier refresh policy. Original transaction rollback remains.

novelty.causal_difference: P7 replaced the entire original iOS17+ LC JIT-less settings section, removing its navigation destination; P91 did not restore it. P91 also gated a host-local signer candidate with canRequestNativeRefresh, a policy that checks an unrelated SideStore signed application identifier; the new path preserves host-team/AppGroup checks but decouples local sign attempts from device refresh readiness.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: P92 JIT-less diagnostic link must appear on iOS27 Settings, open the original native LC screen and record a sanitized manual signature result. On P91 signed host with preflight certificate/team/AppGroup success, signer_recovery_started or an explicit safely classified block must appear after a signature_postcheck_invalid; actual guest success only if kernel postcheck and live guest launch pass.

new_device_evidence.event: jitless_probe_failure_classified/signature_postcheck_invalid without signer_recovery_started and user-reported absent JIT manual diagnostic row
new_device_evidence.observed_value: P91 current session faa1e829 reports four guest launch failures with certificate_invalid and signature_postcheck_invalid; all preflight fields cert/password/team/AppGroup true; no recovery action receipt; original LC diagnostic disappeared from iOS17+ panel.

novelty.why_prior_fix_failed: P78 and P91 focused on candidate P12 sources but left P7 native Settings replacement without a JIT navigation link. P91 introduced a native candidate via XPC but retained canRequestNativeRefresh as a prerequisite for a different local guest signing operation; silent early guards made the failure source invisible.

source_revisions.title: fix(P92): restore original JIT-less diagnostics and decouple guest signer recovery from refresh entitlement gate
test(P92): preserve P78 crash-safe guest signing contract with separate local entitlement gate

entries.action: Restore previously removed original native JIT-less diagnostic NavigationLink in iOS17+ Scarlet signing settings. Record the native manual signature test outcome in Scarlet current-launch JSONL. Repair local guest signer candidate eligibility so it no longer depends on unrelated SideStore device refresh app-identifier check; preserve original signed-host Team/AppGroup and P78 kernel signature rollback.
entries.observation: P91 signed-device session faa1e829 has four certificate_invalid/ signature_postcheck_invalid guest failures and no signer recovery receipts; user cannot find JIT test UI. P92 local Python test suite: 869 run, 866 passed, 3 infrastructure skipped. Native Xcode CI and actual guest launch remain unverified.
entries.evidence: P91 user-supplied current-launch JSONL 2026-11-17 07:45:23Z with exact original LiveContainer JIT view inspected at pinned SHA 9108ae624ea001f7d7696d48407f890b48fa2653; original native Settings integration diff.
entries.next_executable_action: Compile P92 against original LC and SideStore Xcode27.2; check signed device Settings -> JIT-less 진단 -> 원본 테스트 -> 진단 로그 공유. Verify signer_recovery_started / native_signer_recovery_started or explicit reason on P92, then actual kernel-valid guest launch. If signature_postcheck_invalid persists, inspect true native F_ADDFILESIGS and F_CHECK_LV failure mechanisms instead of repeating P12 imports.
entries.repeat_policy: No P12 overwrite without matching Apple team and verified rollback; preserve separate Apple ID account ownership and original V48 guest geometry/status bar. Never treat native CI/ preflight presence as successful signed guest launch.

entries.operation_fingerprint: Read the installed host embedded provisioning profile DeveloperCertificates DER and compare it to the exact X509 certificate extracted from the candidate PKCS12 before any global LiveContainer signer swap.
entries.source_behavior_contract: The selected active Apple ID and host Team still gate XPC; require certificate DER proof against the actual installed host profile even when two accounts share one Team. Never overwrite original P12 on missing proof and retain P78 reversible kernel trial.

novelty.causal_difference: P78 and P91 accepted any same-Team alternate P12 and P91 categorically rejected two accounts sharing one Team. This proposal anchors the same Team candidate to the actual installed host provisioning profile DeveloperCertificates by byte-identical DER before kernel validation, avoiding unrelated certificates from the same Team and allowing a cryptographically evidenced host signer candidate with multiple accounts.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: On a device whose SideStore P12 matches the installed embedded.mobileprovision developer certificate, signer_recovery_trial_started should occur; if no matching private key exists it must explicitly block with a profile mismatch while retaining the original signer, and iOS kernel test remains authoritative.

new_device_evidence.observed_value: signature_postcheck_invalid code 2 repeated with signer_recovery_started 5 and two different account certificate readiness states

novelty.why_prior_fix_failed: P78/P91 and P92 only compared Team OU and registered Apple certificates, not the actual developer certificate authorized by the signed host provisioning profile; P91 also categorically rejected multiple saved owners on one team. P92 iPhone continued kernel code2 despite successful P12 issuance, so this implementation checks host-profile DER provenance before swap.

let options: [String: Any] = [kSecImportExportPassphrase as String: password]
guard SecPKCS12Import(archive as CFData, options as CFDictionary, &decoded)

source_revisions.title: fix(P95): route in-app certificate button through account-owned Apple portal issuer

entries.action: The existing SideStore certificate button now validates one unchanged active AppleID and team, executes original P86 prepare/issue selected Team Apple portal path, revalidates owner, retrieves just-issued or saved native certificate with authenticated XPC, imports only into selected-team store, then invokes original P94 verified host-profile+P78 JITLess recovery. Quota failure and existing cert distinguish from new issue.
entries.observation: Signed-device P94 session 283dc095 confirmed 3.8.94 was installed; guest JIT-less failed signature_postcheck_invalid code2; existing LC signer candidate_not_in_host_profile. The certificate UI recorded provider_origin_checked existing_portal and account_p12_imported ready_existing; this was not new certificate issuance. There is no evidence of successful guest execution.
entries.evidence: User P94 signed-device current-launch 2026-11-17T10:34Z session 283dc095 source fc5613a25976; source P94 button called ScarletNativeCertificateTransport.obtain() backed by global CertificateProvisioningFlow, while P86 independent selected-team native issue path existed but was not called.
entries.next_executable_action: Verify pinned Xcode 27.2 native paired build on branch P95 and release unsigned IPA. On signed iPhone, check native_account_issue_result ready_issued_apple vs ready_existing, current selected Apple-ID owner, host-profile match and JIT-Less kernel postcheck. No proof that Apple can issue if developer certificate quota is exhausted; do not revoke existing certificates. New host certificate requires separately signed host/profile update to avoid guest signer trust mismatch.
entries.repeat_policy: Source fix is UI-to-existing-native-issuer route, not an Apple certificate portal retry or Island layout change. Never delete or revoke certificates or overwrite a different Apple-ID. Signer candidate differing from the installed Scarlet host development profile stays blocked until host is legitimately re-signed and reinstalled without data loss.

entries.operation_fingerprint: On explicit user certificate request require the selected Apple ID owner and Apple portal certificate serial with a matching locally signable private key before reporting reuse; then compare that P12 public DER against the installed host profile to block guest signer trial with a precise error.
entries.source_behavior_contract: Never equate cached certificate expiry with Apple validity, installed host profile trust, or an installed app renewal. Fail closed for mismatched account owner or host signing identity, preserve existing Apple certificates and selected-account XPC storage, and keep kernel test as separate signed-device acceptance.

novelty.causal_difference: L155 connected the button to a prepare-before-issue helper that returns success on a locally non-expired team P12 without Apple portal readback, and L154 still attempts a mismatched host signer. P96 verifies actual portal serial and host profile DER before signaling reuse or guest readiness.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: Signed P96 logs cannot contain native_account_issue_result=ready_existing from only local expiry; valid portal cert reuse reports ready_existing_portal, nonregistered cert must trigger new issue or fail, and host-profile mismatch emits guest signer blocked reason without a kernel trial.
novelty.why_prior_fix_failed: P95 checked only local matching certificate expiry before returning ready_existing; its post-import status said valid even when logged JITLess certificate_invalid and host profile signer mismatch.

## 2026-11-17 P96 / L156 — Apple portal proof and installed-host signer truth

- Signed P95 device log `SourceCommit:9d930382bf1d`, `Build:3.8.95`, session `ae30a2fc`: twice `native_account_issue_result=ready_existing`, but `jitless_host_profile_signer_readback=candidate_not_in_host_profile` and `signature_postcheck_invalid` code2. `sidestore_managed_apps_inspected count=0 reason=no_managed_apps_for_selected_team` blocks APP refresh independently of P12. Account switch verified; later account import blocked, reason redacted, so do not claim which account failed until new visible safe category.

- Code cause: P95 `ensureSelectedTeamCertificate` fast-returns after local OU + X509 expiry `prepare`, before checking Apple's current Developer Portal serial list. It then says an existing valid certificate was reused even when the installed host profile rejects that signer. These are three different states: Apple-registered key, host-signed JIT-Less trust, managed app refresh eligibility.

- P96 functional strategy: explicit existing certificate button directly calls native account-owner-verified `issueInstallCertificate`, where `issue` fetches Apple portal certificate serials BEFORE reusing a cached P12, uses only an unexpired portal-listed serial and matching local private key, or creates a new Apple certificate without revoking existing ones; owner is rechecked across awaits. A successful per-account P12 import checks installed host profile exact X509 DER BEFORE attempting P78 reversible guest-signer recovery. It visibly reports a host re-sign requirement on mismatch, and stops a failed selected-account import before issuing a native provider success receipt. Never conflate `no_managed_apps_for_selected_team` with certificate expiry.

- Maintain V48 UI scale/status bar/Island/switcher/audio, unchanged original Apple IDs, P12 Keychains, bundle ID, and non-destructive updates. No Apple portal account issuance, host re-sign or real iPhone JIT-Less success is verified by Python or Xcode CI.

- New signed-device gates: `native_account_issue_result=ready_existing_portal` only after Apple portal serial match, or `ready_issued_apple` only after actual portal creation. If P12 fails `account_p12_guest_signer_blocked` with `candidate_not_in_host_profile`, re-sign installed host using its exact approved developer certificate/profile; never blindly swap another account's private key. Only `signer_recovery_verified` with kernel success followed by actual guest display can close the guest-launch issue.
